lessons.title: Matematika - Algebra
lessons.subject: mathematics
lessons.content: Algebra - matematikaning eng muhim bo'limlaridan biri. Unda sonlar va belgilar yordamida tenglamalar yechiladi. Algebra o'quvchilarga mantiqiy fikrlashni o'rgatadi va real hayotdagi muammolarni yechishga yordam beradi. Tenglamalar, o'zgaruvchilar va funksiyalar - algebraning asosiy tushunchalari.

questions.question: 2x + 5 = 15 tenglamani yeching.
x² - 9 = 0 tenglamani yeching.
3x - 7 = 14 tenglamada x ning qiymatini toping.

lessons.title: Fizika - Mexanika
lessons.subject: physics
lessons.content: Mexanika - fizikaning jismlarning harakatini o'rganadigan bo'limi. Nyuton qonunlari mexanikaning asosini tashkil qiladi. Birinchi qonun: Tashqi kuch ta'sir qilmasa, jism tinch turadi yoki bir xil tezlik bilan harakat qiladi. Ikkinchi qonun: Kuch jismning massasi va tezlanishiga teng. Uchinchi qonun: Har bir ta'sir qiluvchi kuchga teng va qarama-qarshi yo'nalishda reaksiya kuchi mavjud.

questions.question: Nyutonning birinchi qonuni nima haqida?
questions.explanation: Birinchi qonun inersiya qonuni deb ham yuritiladi.

questions.question: F = m * a formulasi qaysi qonunga tegishli?
Agar 10 kg massali jismga 20 N kuch ta'sir etsa, tezlanish qancha bo'ladi?

lessons.title: Ingliz Tili - Grammar
lessons.subject: english
lessons.content: English grammar is the foundation of effective communication. Present Simple tense is used for habits and facts. For example: 'I study every day.' Past Simple describes completed actions: 'I studied yesterday.' Future Simple talks about tomorrow: 'I will study tomorrow.' Understanding these tenses is essential for fluent English speaking.

questions.question: She ___ to school every day.
questions.explanation: Present Simple - third person singular adds 'es'.

questions.question: Yesterday, I ___ my homework.
Tomorrow, we ___ the exam.

lessons.title: Kimyo - Elementlar
lessons.subject: chemistry
lessons.content: Kimyo - moddaning tarkibi, tuzilishi va xossalari o'rganadigan fan. Davriy jadval 118 elementni o'z ichiga oladi. Vodorod - eng yengil element, kislorod - hayot uchun muhim. Kimyoviy reaksiyalarda atomlar qayta tuziladi, lekin yo'qolmaydi. Mendeleyev davriy jadvalni kashf qildi va elementlarni tartibli ravishda joylashtirdi.

questions.question: Davriy jadvelda nechta element bor?
Vodorodning belgisi nima?
Kislorodning atom raqami qancha?

lessons.title: Tarix - O'zbekiston
lessons.subject: history
lessons.content: O'zbekiston - qadimiy Buyuk Ipak Yo'li bo'ylab joylashgan mamlakat. Samarqand, Buxoro, Xiva - qadimiy shaharlar. Amir Temur XV asrda buyuk imperiya qurdi. O'zbekiston 1991 yilda mustaqillikka erishdi. Mamlakatda boy madaniyat va tarix mavjud. Qadimiy davrda Movarounnahr deb atalgan bu hudud ko'plab olimlar yetishib chiqqan.

questions.question: O'zbekiston qachon mustaqil bo'ldi?
Amir Temur qaysi asrda yashagan?
questions.explanation: Amir Temur 1336-1405 yillarda yashagan, XIV asr oxiri - XV asr boshlari.

questions.question: Qaysi shahar 'Sharq qalasi' deb ataladi?

lessons.title: Biologiya - Hujayralar
lessons.subject: biology
lessons.content: Hujayra - tirik organizmning asosiy birligi. Har bir hujayra yadro, sitoplazma va membranadan iborat. O'simlik hujayralarida devor va xloroplastlar mavjud. Hayvon hujayralarida esa yo'q. Mitoxondriya - energiya ishlab chiqaruvchi organell. Hujayralar bo'linib ko'payadi va organizmni rivojlantiradi.

questions.question: Hujayraning energiya ishlab chiqaruvchi organelli qaysi?
O'simlik hujayralarida qaysi qisma hayvon hujayralarida yo'q?
questions.explanation: Hujayra devori faqat o'simlik hujayralarida mavjud.

questions.question: DNK qaysi qismda joylashgan?

lessons.title: Geografiya - O'zbekiston
lessons.subject: geography
lessons.content: O'zbekiston Markaziy Osiyoda joylashgan. Maydoni - 448,978 kvadrat kilometr. Qo'shni davlatlar: Qozog'iston, Qirg'iziston, Tojikiston, Turkmaniston va Afg'oniston. Poytaxti - Toshkent. Iqlimi - kontinental. Yozda issiq, qishda sovuq. Amudaryo va Sirdaryo - asosiy daryolar. Qoraqum va Qizilqum cho'llari mavjud.

questions.question: O'zbekistonning maydoni qancha?
O'zbekiston nechta qo'shni davlatga ega?
O'zbekistonning poytaxti qaysi shahar?

lessons.title: Dasturlash - Python Asoslari
lessons.subject: programming
lessons.content: Python - oddiy va kuchli dasturlash tili. O'rganish oson, sintaksisi aniq. O'zgaruvchilarni e'lon qilish shart emas. print() funksiyasi ma'lumot chiqarish uchun ishlatiladi. Python ma'lumotlar turlari: integer, float, string, boolean. Shart operatorlari: if, elif, else. Sikllar: for, while. Funksiyalar def bilan yaratiladi.

questions.question: Python'da ma'lumot chiqarish uchun qaysi funksiya ishlatiladi?
Quyidagi qaysi to'g'ri o'zgaruvchi e'loni?
Python'da funksiya qanday yaratiladi?
questions.explanation: Python'da funksiya def kalit so'zi bilan yaratiladi.

lessons.title: IELTS - Listening Module
lessons.subject: ielts
lessons.content: IELTS Listening Module - 40 questions, 4 sections. Section 1: Form completion (10 questions). Section 2: Multiple choice (10 questions). Section 3: Academic lecture (10 questions). Section 4: Complex discussion (10 questions). Total time: 30 minutes. Each correct answer earns 1 point. Band score calculated from raw score (0-40). Focus on understanding main ideas, specific details, and following academic discussions.

questions.question: What is the main topic of the lecture?
questions.explanation: The lecture focuses on renewable energy sources.

questions.question: According to the speaker, what percentage of energy comes from solar power?
questions.explanation: The speaker mentions 40% solar energy contribution.

questions.question: What challenge does the speaker mention?
questions.explanation: Both cost and storage are mentioned as challenges.

lessons.title: IELTS - Reading Module
lessons.subject: ielts
lessons.content: IELTS Reading Module - 40 questions, 3 passages. Passage 1: 13 questions (easy). Passage 2: 13 questions (medium). Passage 3: 14 questions (hard). Total time: 60 minutes. Question types: True/False/Not Given, Multiple Choice, Matching Headings, Summary Completion. Focus on skimming, scanning, and detailed comprehension. Academic texts from journals, magazines, and books.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is one major benefit of AI in education?
questions.explanation: The passage highlights personalized learning as a key benefit.

questions.question: How does AI help with assessment according to the text?
questions.explanation: AI provides instant feedback to students.

questions.question: What challenge does the passage mention regarding AI in education?
questions.explanation: Privacy concerns are mentioned as a significant challenge.

lessons.title: IELTS - Writing Task 1
lessons.subject: ielts
lessons.content: IELTS Writing Task 1 - Academic. Describe visual information: graphs, charts, tables, diagrams, or maps. Minimum 150 words. Time: 20 minutes. Task Achievement (25%), Coherence & Cohesion (25%), Lexical Resource (25%), Grammar (25%). Focus on identifying main trends, comparing data, and reporting key features objectively without opinion.

questions.question: What is the minimum word count for Task 1?
How much time is allocated for Task 1?
What are the four assessment criteria for Task 1?
options: Task Achievement, Coherence, Lexical Resource, Grammar
questions.explanation: The four criteria are Task Achievement, Coherence & Cohesion, Lexical Resource, and Grammar.

lessons.title: IELTS - Writing Task 2
lessons.subject: ielts
lessons.content: IELTS Writing Task 2 - Academic Essay. Respond to a point of view, argument, or problem. Minimum 250 words. Time: 40 minutes. Task Response (25%), Coherence & Cohesion (25%), Lexical Resource (25%), Grammar (25%). Focus on developing arguments, providing examples, and maintaining formal academic style. Task 2 counts for 2/3 of total writing score.

questions.question: What is the minimum word count for Task 2?
How much time is allocated for Task 2?
What percentage of the total writing score does Task 2 represent?
questions.explanation: Task 2 accounts for 2/3 of the total writing score.

lessons.title: IELTS - Speaking Part 1
lessons.subject: ielts
lessons.content: IELTS Speaking Part 1 - Introduction & Interview. Duration: 4-5 minutes. Topics: Work/Studies, Home/Accommodation, Hometown, Family, Hobbies, Daily Routine. Assessment: Fluency & Coherence (25%), Lexical Resource (25%), Grammar (25%), Pronunciation (25%). Focus on natural conversation, expanding answers, and showing range of vocabulary.

questions.question: How long does Speaking Part 1 last?
What are the main topics in Part 1?
options: Personal topics like work, home, hobbies
questions.explanation: Part 1 covers personal topics familiar to the candidate.

questions.question: What are the four assessment criteria for Speaking?
questions.explanation: Speaking is assessed on Fluency, Lexical Resource, Grammar, and Pronunciation.

lessons.title: IELTS - Speaking Part 2
lessons.subject: ielts
lessons.content: IELTS Speaking Part 2 - Individual Long Turn. Duration: 3-4 minutes. 1 minute preparation, 2 minutes speaking. Cue card topic: Describe a person, place, object, or event. Assessment: Fluency, Vocabulary, Grammar, Pronunciation. Focus on structured response, using examples, and maintaining fluency for the full 2 minutes.

questions.question: How long is the preparation time in Part 2?
How long should you speak in Part 2?
What do you receive in Part 2?
options: A cue card with topic points
questions.explanation: You receive a cue card with topic points to discuss.

lessons.title: IELTS - Speaking Part 3
lessons.subject: ielts
lessons.content: IELTS Speaking Part 3 - Two-way Discussion. Duration: 4-5 minutes. Topics related to Part 2 but more abstract and complex. Discussion questions: Social issues, Technology, Education, Environment, Globalization. Assessment: Fluency, Vocabulary, Grammar, Pronunciation. Focus on expressing opinions, justifying answers, and discussing abstract concepts.

questions.question: How long does Speaking Part 3 last?
What type of topics are discussed in Part 3?
options: Abstract and complex topics related to Part 2
questions.explanation: Part 3 discusses abstract topics related to Part 2.

questions.question: What should you focus on in Part 3?
questions.explanation: Focus on expressing opinions and providing justifications.
